propositions: The context window check in pai_retry never executes on first requests because the filter only descends into ModelResponse messages, leaving a [ModelRequest] history unreachable to the raise site.

Oversized first requests (3.6M chars against 1M token window) pass through unchecked and surface as LLMUnavailableError ('provider call failed') rather than ContextWindowExceededError, misclassifying deterministic input problems as provider outages.

A request-side fit check must be added to the wire projection's proc callable using 4 chars/token calibration to keep enrich's window*2-char bound admissible while catching gross overflows before any provider call.
The seam must raise one fail-closed ContextWindowExceededError matching errors.py's documented request-terms contract, leaving per-op bounds as first-line guards with the seam as backstop.
